description: Rank every served area (or one region's, region='North West') by one metric for one month and return the top N with rank, value, unit and quality. Tied values share a rank (competition ranking); each row carries tiedCount, the number of areas sharing its value. Use it to answer 'which areas have the lowest crime / highest GBP/m2' or 'the least deprived' (deprivation is the official IMD decile, 10 = least deprived: order desc), 'the highest household income' (income, GBP a year) or 'the most social renting' (social-renting, % of households; neutral, never call it better or worse). Areas with suppressed values are excluded. Census layers (census-*, student-share) describe residents and are refused: never rank areas by who lives there. The find_areas factors disorder, epc-share, leasehold-share and schools rank too (latest value, period ignored).

region.description: Only areas of one English region: its code (E12000001-E12000009) or name, e.g. 'North West', 'London'. Omitted: every area Close Knit covers.
